items.desc_now: Project agent - a DSH plugin for large projects: a project agent session, isolated task sessions and a shared file pool, with an audit trail and hand-off between stages. English version (default branch); Russian version in the 'ru' branch.
items.desc_prev: Project agent — a DSH plugin for running large projects: work is split into separate task sessions, while the main projectAgent session keeps the project context. The plugin is designed to make this work easier and to prevent memory degradation when running a project: instead of one overloaded session — several isolated ones, with a shared file.
